steps.note: the API built this case's state
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the existing RFQ.
Open the RFQ stage's Responses tab where the submitted bids and Reject controls are available.

args.goal: On the buyer's RFQ Responses screen, reject Vendor A with a reason and then reject Vendor B with a reason; stop when both rejection actions have completed successfully.

steps.note: Perform the two vendor-specific rejection actions that have no dedicated domain step.
Open the RFQ stage's Rejected Bids view to verify both rejected vendors are recorded.
Confirm Vendor A appears in the rejected bids list.
Confirm Vendor B appears in the rejected bids list.
Open Master QCS to inspect the post-rejection comparison state.
Verify that no rankable vendor bid remains in Master QCS after both bids are rejected.
Verify that awarding cannot proceed when both bids have been rejected.
